purpose: Authorize one future-only image-bound v3 E2 lineage from a newly rebuilt, all-prior-lineage-excluded OOF candidate pool after the prescreen-v2 pool was exhausted.

evidence.predecessor_result: Tenth prescreen-v2 collection closed at 27 selected, three quality rejections, and two terminal delivery shortfalls; it cannot enter rewrite.
evidence.pool_isolation: 80 paths exist; each image/source/near-duplicate identity is unique and has zero overlap with 616 identities from all earlier E2 source lineages.
evidence.quality_attribution: Across ten closed prescreen-v2 collections, P1 had 108 selected and four confirmed quality rejections; P6 had 39 selected and one confirmed quality rejection. This is directional sampling evidence only, not a relaxed acceptance rule.
evidence.failed_uniform_recipe: Rebuilding the old P1-P6 five-per-cell recipe after full exclusion failed because option/zh/disease P4 had fewer than five candidates.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Freeze exactly four fresh identities per fixed cell from prescreen-v3 only, excluding all preceding E2 sources across image/source/near-duplicate identity. Select lower candidate patterns first, yielding P1-first selection with P6 and random rows only as deterministic fallback.

qualification: The new lineage retains the exact 32 unique collection winners, four rows per fixed cell, accepted image-bound rewrite, accepted independent private rewrite audit, and conversion-gate requirements. Quality rejects and R2 delivery shortfalls remain terminal. SFT remains separately unauthorized.
